name: Blue Bowl Superfoods
tagline: Build-your-own superfood bowls with unlimited toppings, organic bases, and house-made nut butters
description: A celebrated Old Towne phenomenon, Blue Bowl revolutionized healthy dining with its 100% customizable, unlimited-topping superfood bowl model. Located in a historic arched-window storefront on North Glassell Street, guests create custom layered masterpieces from nutrient-dense bases like pure organic açaí, blue majik, pitaya, matcha, and activated coconut chia pudding, topped with house-made nut butters, gluten-free granolas, super seeds, and fresh coastal berries.
historicNote: Located in a handsome multi-story 1920s brick building featuring classical arched second-story windows and awning-shaded sidewalk seating.

specials.title: Monday Morning Superfood Boost
specials.description: Start the week with $1 off any 16oz or 24oz bowl layered with Blue Majik and matcha spirulina bases.

specials.title: Double Nut Butter Tuesday
specials.description: Complimentary second dollop of freshly ground house peanut, almond, or cashew butter drizzled over your custom bowl.

specials.title: Chapman Student Wellness Wednesday
specials.description: Show valid Chapman University student or faculty ID and receive 10% off any bowl, smoothie, or loaded avocado bagel.

specials.title: Thirsty Thursday Smoothie Pairing
specials.description: $2 off any handcrafted layered cold-pressed smoothie when paired with a signature morning or lunch bowl.

specials.title: TGIF Vibrant Pitaya Passion Bowl
specials.description: Feature Friday: Organic red dragonfruit pitaya base loaded with fresh strawberries, kiwi, and cacao nibs with free hemp seed dusting.

specials.title: Weekend Post-Run Recovery Bowl
specials.description: Protein-boosted base with house-made vanilla almond granola, chia seeds, fresh blueberries, and raw honey drizzle.

specials.title: Sunday Afternoon Treat & Stroll
specials.description: Buy two large 24oz custom bowls and receive 50% off a kid's or mini bowl for your stroll around The Circle.

events.title: Old Towne Community Run Club & Açaí Social
events.description: Casual 3-mile morning neighborhood run around the historic district followed by post-run cold brew, recovery bowl specials, and social patio time.
